prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Rusher. The one reference defines creature identity/silhouette and view. Redraw continuous actions of this same creature. Matte dark brown rock armor, pale gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye slit, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree game camera, upper-left soft light. Lean athletic quadruped with very long sharp spear/wedge-shaped head and tall swept-back layered rocky armor blade along spine; dark brown plates, pale gray sinewy load-bearing legs, amber eye slit at front. FOUR limbs, single head; no sacs, no flower organs. Preserve the reference's blade-backed charging predator silhouette.
Direction ALL frames: REAR THREE-QUARTER facing away toward upper-right, rear legs nearest viewer, nose toward upper-right. Never front-right. No angle changes during skill or death.
Strict layout FOUR columns x 7 rows = 28 separate full drawings. Tall PORTRAIT canvas, width-to-height ratio 4:7. IMPORTANT: not landscape. Empty transparent margin takes 20 percent on every side of EVERY cell, including space between rows. Full silhouettes including legs must NEVER touch adjacent poses. All drawings same scale, central placement and foot baseline. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real articulated four-leg gait, alternating diagonal pairs, lifted feet and planted feet, stable torso. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breath poses, feet planted. Row4: FOUR WINDUP frames: progressively brace hind legs, lower spear head, draw torso backward ready to charge; last frame fully braced. Rows5-6: EIGHT sequential CHARGE SPRINT frames, head lowered and armor forward, vigorous alternating reach/push leg motions, body stays at the same scale and ground anchor. Row7: FOUR DEATH frames: limbs buckle, spear head and plates settle on floor, eyes darken, collapsed corpse, no explosion.
Real articulated movement, no exact duplicate or transformed still frames. Four legs, single head, consistent anatomy and armor. True alpha0 transparent empty canvas including gaps inside limbs; no floor, shadow, opaque backdrop, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
